domain: Online payment processing platform handling real-time card authorisations for e-commerce merchants.

glossary.definition: Core transaction processing component responsible for card authorisation, settlement, and refund operations.
Scheduled period during which the platform undergoes planned updates, patches, or infrastructure changes.

business_rules.rule: The payment service is subject to a maximum of four scheduled maintenance windows per year, each not exceeding two hours, during which transaction processing is suspended.

constraints.text: Availability targets must be expressed as a percentage with explicit exclusions for scheduled maintenance, and must be measurable over a defined rolling period (e.g. 99.95% over any 30-day window).
